_comment: DISPLAY TEXT FOR JS/DB/HEALTH/DISEASES.JSON, WHICH IZ REGENERATED BY TOOLS/HEALTH/GEN_DISEASES.PY AN' THEREFORE NEVER CARRIES A TRANSLATION. HEALTH_DISEASESYSTEM._LOCALIZE LAYS DIS OVER A PRIVATE COPY OF DA DB, KEYED BY ID; ONLY NAME, DESC AN' DA SYMPTOM LABELS IZ REPLACED!

adenovirus.name: ADENOVIRUS
adenovirus.desc: A COMMON RESPIRATORY VIRUS SPREAD THROUGH DROPLETS AN' CONTACT. SORE THROAT, CONJUNCTIVITIS AN' FEVER RESEMBLE A COLD DAT LINGERS LONGER DEN USUAL!

aether-lung.name: AETHER LUNG
aether-lung.desc: PROLONGED INHALATION OF RAW, UNCONDENSED AETHER CRYSTALLIZES ALONG DA ALVEOLI. DA LININ' GLOWS FAINTLY UNDER STRAIN, AN' EACH BREATH GROWS SHORTER DEN DA LAST!

aids.name: AIDS
aids.desc: ADVANCED HIV INFECTION IN WHICH DA IMMUNE SYSTEM HAB COLLAPSED. WASTIN' AN' OPPORTUNISTIC INFECTIONS TAKE HOLD ONCE CD4 CELL COUNTS FALL TOO LOW TA FIGHT BACK!

alzheimers.name: ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE
alzheimers.desc: DA MOST COMMON CAUSE OF DEMENTIA, MARKED BY PROGRESSIVE LOSS OF NEURONS. MEMORY FOR RECENT EVENTS FAILS FIRST, FOLLOWED BY LANGUAGE AN' ORIENTATION!

amoebiasis.name: AMOEBIC DYSENTERY
amoebiasis.desc: INTESTINAL INFECTION BY ENTAMOEBA HISTOLYTICA. DA AMOEBA ERODES DA GUT LININ', PRODUCIN' CRAMPIN' AN', IN SEVERE CASES, BLOODY DIARRHEA!

anemia.name: IRON-DEFICIENCY ANEMIA
anemia.desc: A SHORTAGE OF RED BLOOD CELLS CAUSED BY INSUFFICIENT IRON. DA BLOOD CARRIES LESS OXYGEN, LEAVIN' DA BODY PALE, WEAK AN' EASILY WINDED!

anthrax.name: ANTHRAX
anthrax.desc: INFECTION BY BACILLUS ANTHRACIS SPORES, WHETHER THROUGH DA SKIN, LUNGS, OR GUT. SKIN EXPOSURE PRODUCES A BLACK, PAINLESS ESCHAR; INHALED SPORES BRING RAPID BREATHLESSNESS!

anxiety.name: GENERALIZED ANXIETY
anxiety.desc: A DISORDER OF EXCESSIVE, HARD-TA-CONTROL WORRY DAT OUTLASTS ITS TRIGGER. MUSCLE TENSION AN' RESTLESSNESS ACCOMPANY DREAD ABOUT ORDINARY, EVERYDAY MATTERS!

arrhythmia.name: CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIA
arrhythmia.desc: AN IRREGULARITY IN DA HEART'S ELECTRICAL RHYTHM, TOO FAST, TOO SLOW, OR ERRATIC. PALPITATIONS AN' FAINTIN' SPELLS CAN SIGNAL DA HEART FALLIN' OUT OF SYNC!

ascariasis.name: ROUNDWORM
ascariasis.desc: INFECTION BY A LARGE INTESTINAL ROUNDWORM, ACQUIRED BY SWALLOWIN' ITS EGGS. HEAVY WORM BURDENS CAUSE ABDOMINAL DISTENSION AN' ROB DA BODY OF NUTRITION!

aspergillosis.name: ASPERGILLOSIS
aspergillosis.desc: A MOLD INFECTION OF DA LUNGS, USUALLY IN DOZE WIT PRIOR LUNG DISEASE OR A WEAKENED IMMUNE SYSTEM. PERSISTENT COUGH AN' WHEEZE AS SPORES COLONIZE DA AIRWAY!

asphalt-cough.name: ASPHALT COUGH
asphalt-cough.desc: OCCUPATIONAL ASTHMA TRIGGERED BY PROLONGED EXPOSURE TA AIRBORNE IRRITANTS ON DA JOB. DA AIRWAYS NARROW AN' INFLAME EACH TIME DA TRIGGER IZ ENCOUNTERED!

asthma.name: ASTHMA
asthma.desc: CHRONIC INFLAMMATION OF DA AIRWAYS DAT NARROWS DEM IN RESPONSE TA TRIGGERS. WHEEZIN' AN' SHORTNESS OF BREATH COME IN EPISODES RATHER DEN CONSTANTLY!

athletes-foot.name: ATHLETE'S FOOT
athletes-foot.desc: A FUNGAL INFECTION OF DA SKIN BETWEEN DA TOES, THRIVIN' IN WARM, DAMP FOOTWEAR. ITCHIN', SCALIN' AN' CRACKIN' OF DA SKIN!

b12-deficiency.name: B12 DEFICIENCY
b12-deficiency.desc: A SHORTAGE OF VITAMIN B12 DAT IMPAIRS RED BLOOD CELL FORMATION AN' NERVE FUNCTION. FATIGUE AN' NUMBNESS IN DA EXTREMITIES DEVELOP AS DEFICIENCY PROGRESSES!

babesiosis.name: BABESIOSIS
babesiosis.desc: A TICK-BORNE PARASITE DAT INFECTS RED BLOOD CELLS, SIMILAR TA MALARIA. FEVER AN' HEMOLYTIC ANEMIA FOLLOW DA PARASITE'S DESTRUCTION OF INFECTED CELLS!

bedbugs.name: BEDBUGS
bedbugs.desc: SMALL BLOOD-FEEDIN' INSECTS DAT HIDE IN BEDDIN' AN' FEED AT NIGHT. DEY BITES RAISE ITCHY WELTS, OFTEN IN A TELLTALE LINE, AN' DISRUPT SLEEP!

bells-palsy.name: BELL'S PALSY
bells-palsy.desc: SUDDEN, USUALLY ONE-SIDED FACIAL NERVE PARALYSIS OF UNCLEAR CAUSE. DA AFFECTED SIDE OF DA FACE DROOPS, UNABLE TA SMILE, BLINK OR RAISE AN EYEBROW!

beriberi.name: BERIBERI
beriberi.desc: THIAMINE DEFICIENCY DAT DISRUPTS NERVE AN' CARDIAC FUNCTION. NERVE DAMAGE OR FLUID RETENTION DEVELOP DEPENDIN' ON WHICH SYSTEM FAILS FIRST!

bipolar.name: BIPOLAR DISORDER
bipolar.desc: A MOOD DISORDER CYCLIN' BETWEEN DEPRESSIVE LOWS AN' ABNORMALLY ELEVATED HIGHS. MANIC EPISODES BRING RECKLESS ENERGY; DEPRESSIVE ONES BRING ITS COLLAPSE!

black-mold.name: BLACK MOLD SICKNESS
black-mold.desc: CHRONIC EXPOSURE TA STACHYBOTRYS SPORES IN DAMP BUILDINGS. HEADACHE, BRAIN FOG AN' COUGH ACCUMULATE DA LONGER EXPOSURE CONTINUES!

bloom-fungus.name: CORPSE BLOOM
bloom-fungus.desc: A PARASITIC FUNGUS DAT HIJACKS ITS HOST'S NERVOUS SYSTEM BEFORE FRUITIN' THROUGH DA FLESH. INFECTION ENDS ONLY ONCE DA FUNGUS HAB FINISHED GROWIN'!

botulism.name: BOTULISM
botulism.desc: PARALYTIC POISONIN' FROM CLOSTRIDIUM BOTULINUM TOXIN. BLURRED VISION AN' WEAKNESS SPREAD FROM DA FACE DOWNWARD AS NERVE SIGNALS IZ BLOCKED!

brain-eating-amoeba.name: NAEGLERIASIS
brain-eating-amoeba.desc: A RARE BUT ALMOST ALWAYS FATAL INFECTION IN WHICH A FREE-LIVIN' AMOEBA TRAVELS UP DA OLFACTORY NERVE INTO DA BRAIN AFTER ENTERIN' THROUGH DA NOSE. HEADACHE AN' LOSS OF SMELL PROGRESS RAPIDLY TA HALLUCINATION AN' COMA!

brucellosis.name: BRUCELLOSIS
brucellosis.desc: A BACTERIAL ZOONOSIS CONTRACTED FROM UNPASTEURIZED MILK OR CLOSE ANIMAL CONTACT. FEVER DAT RISES AN' FALLS, DRENCHIN' SWEATS AN' JOINT PAIN GIVE IT DA NAME UNDULANT FEVER!

campylobacter.name: CAMPYLOBACTERIOSIS
campylobacter.desc: ONE OF DA MOST COMMON BACTERIAL CAUSES OF FOODBORNE ILLNESS. CRAMPIN' AN' DIARRHEA, SOMETIMES BLOODY, FOLLOW UNDERCOOKED POULTRY OR CONTAMINATED WATER!

candidiasis.name: CANDIDIASIS
candidiasis.desc: OVERGROWTH OF CANDIDA YEAST, NORMALLY HELD IN CHECK BY DA BODY'S FLORA. WHITE PATCHES OR ITCHIN' DISCHARGE APPEAR AT DA AFFECTED MUCOUS MEMBRANE!

celiac.name: CELIAC DISEASE
celiac.desc: AN AUTOIMMUNE REACTION TA GLUTEN DAT DAMAGES DA LININ' OF DA SMALL INTESTINE. BLOATIN' AN' MALABSORPTION FOLLOW EXPOSURE TA WHEAT, BARLEY OR RYE!

chagas.name: CHAGAS DISEASE
chagas.desc: INFECTION WIT TRYPANOSOMA CRUZI, TRANSMITTED BY DA BITE OF A TRIATOMINE KISSIN' BUG. ACUTE SWELLIN' GIVES WAY TA SLOW, SILENT DAMAGE TA HEART MUSCLE OVER DECADES!

chickenpox.name: CHICKENPOX
chickenpox.desc: PRIMARY INFECTION WIT VARICELLA-ZOSTER VIRUS. AN ITCHY, BLISTERIN' RASH SPREADS FROM DA TRUNK OUTWARD, SCABBIN' OVER WITHIN A WEEK OR TWO!

chigoe.name: CHIGOE FLEA
chigoe.desc: A BURROWIN' FLEA DAT EMBEDS ITSELF IN DA SKIN, USUALLY OF DA FOOT, TA FEED AN' SWELL WIT EGGS. A PAINFUL, ITCHY LESION FORMS AROUND DA BURIED INSECT!

chikungunya.name: CHIKUNGUNYA
chikungunya.desc: A MOSQUITO-BORNE VIRUS NAMED FOR DA CONTORTED POSTURE IT FORCES ON SUFFERERS. FEVER AN' SEVERE, OFTEN CRIPPLIN' JOINT PAIN FOLLOW DA BITE!

chlamydia.name: CHLAMYDIA
chlamydia.desc: DA MOST COMMON BACTERIAL SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED INFECTION, OFTEN SYMPTOMLESS. DISCHARGE OR BURNIN' APPEARS WEEKS AFTER EXPOSURE WHEN IT DOES PRESENT!

cholera.name: CHOLERA
cholera.desc: ACUTE INTESTINAL INFECTION BY VIBRIO CHOLERAE. PROFUSE WATERY DIARRHEA CAN CAUSE FATAL DEHYDRATION WITHIN HOURS IF FLUIDS IZ NOT REPLACED!

chronic-lyme.name: LATE DISSEMINATED LYME
chronic-lyme.desc: LYME DISEASE LEFT UNTREATED UNTIL DA BACTERIA DISSEMINATE WIDELY. ARTHRITIS, NERVE DAMAGE AN' FACIAL PALSY DEVELOP AS DA INFECTION REACHES JOINTS AN' NERVES!

chrono-ague.name: CHRONAL AGUE
chrono-ague.desc: EXPOSURE TA UNSTABLE TEMPORAL FIELDS CAUSES LOCALIZED AGING INCONSISTENT WIT ELAPSED TIME. SUFFERERS EXPERIENCE BRIEF SLIPS WHERE PERCEIVED TIME AN' PHYSICAL TIME DIVERGE!

cirrhosis.name: HEPATIC CIRRHOSIS
cirrhosis.desc: IRREVERSIBLE SCARRIN' OF DA LIVER FROM CHRONIC DISEASE. HEALTHY TISSUE IZ REPLACED BY FIBROUS NODULES, AN' JAUNDICE AN' FLUID BUILDUP FOLLOW AS FUNCTION FAILS!

cjd.name: CREUTZFELDT-JAKOB DISEASE
cjd.desc: A PRION DISEASE IN WHICH MISFOLDED PROTEINS DESTROY BRAIN TISSUE. RAPID DEMENTIA, MUSCLE JERKS AN' LOSS OF COORDINATION PROGRESS OVER MONTHS TA DEATH!

cmv.name: CYTOMEGALOVIRUS
cmv.desc: A HERPESVIRUS DAT ESTABLISHES LIFELONG LATENCY AFTER INFECTION. USUALLY SILENT, IT CAN CAUSE PROLONGED FATIGUE AN' MONONUCLEOSIS-LIKE ILLNESS!

cocoon-blight.name: COCOON BLIGHT
cocoon-blight.desc: A SLOW HARDENIN' OF DA OUTER SKIN INTO A CHRYSALIS-LIKE SHELL. LETHARGY DEEPENS AS METABOLIC ACTIVITY REDIRECTS TOWARD DA HARDENIN' PROCESS!

collective-vision.name: COLLECTIVE VISION
collective-vision.desc: A STATE OF COLLECTIVE EFFERVESCENCE, IN WHICH A GATHERED CROWD SHARES DA SAME INTENSE THOUGHT OR VISION AT ONCE. DA SHARED EUPHORIA CAN LEAVE DA GROUP SLEEPLESS!

common-cold.name: COMMON COLD
common-cold.desc: A MILD UPPER RESPIRATORY INFECTION, USUALLY RHINOVIRUS. SNEEZIN', CONGESTION AN' A SORE THROAT DAT CLEAR WITHIN A WEEK WITHOUT TREATMENT!

convent-mimicry.name: CONVENT MIMICRY
convent-mimicry.desc: MASS PSYCHOGENIC ILLNESS SPREADIN' THROUGH A CLOSED COMMUNITY. SYMPTOMS AN' BEHAVIORS PASS FROM PERSON TA PERSON WIT NO ORGANIC CAUSE BEHIND DEM!

copd.name: COPD
copd.desc: PROGRESSIVE LUNG DAMAGE, USUALLY FROM LONG-TERM IRRITANT EXPOSURE, DAT NARROWS DA AIRWAYS PERMANENTLY. BREATHIN' GROWS HARDER OVER YEARS, NOT DAYS!

covid.name: NOVEL CORONAVIRUS
covid.desc: RESPIRATORY INFECTION FROM SARS-COV-2. FEVER, DRY COUGH AN' LOSS OF SMELL IZ TYPICAL; SEVERITY RANGES FROM ASYMPTOMATIC TA ACUTE RESPIRATORY DISTRESS!

crab-lice.name: CRAB LICE
crab-lice.desc: A PUBIC-HAIR-DWELLIN' LOUSE SPREAD THROUGH CLOSE CONTACT. PERSISTENT ITCHIN' AN' SMALL BLUE BITE MARKS APPEAR WHERE DA LICE HAB FED!

crimean-congo.name: CRIMEAN-CONGO HEMORRHAGIC FEVER
crimean-congo.desc: A TICK-BORNE VIRAL HEMORRHAGIC FEVER WIT A HIGH FATALITY RATE IN SEVERE CASES. FEVER AN' BRUISIN' PROGRESS TA BLEEDIN' UNDER DA SKIN WITHIN TWO WEEKS OF EXPOSURE!

crohns.name: CROHN'S DISEASE
crohns.desc: A FORM OF INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE DAT CAN AFFECT ANY PART OF DA DIGESTIVE TRACT. CRAMPIN' AN' DIARRHEA FLARE AS DA GUT LININ' BECOMES INFLAMED!

cryptococcosis.name: CRYPTOCOCCOSIS
cryptococcosis.desc: A FUNGAL INFECTION DAT COLONIZES DA LUNGS BEFORE SPREADIN' TA DA BRAIN. HEADACHE AN' CONFUSION MARK MENINGITIS ONCE IT REACHES DA CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM!

cryptosporidiosis.name: CRYPTOSPORIDIOSIS
cryptosporidiosis.desc: A WATERBORNE PROTOZOAN PARASITE RESISTANT TA STANDARD CHLORINATION. WATERY DIARRHEA FOLLOWS INGESTION OF ITS CYSTS, PARTICULARLY FROM CONTAMINATED RECREATIONAL WATER!

dancing-plague.name: DANCIN' FEVER
dancing-plague.desc: A DOCUMENTED OUTBREAK OF COMPULSIVE, INVOLUNTARY DANCIN', MOST LIKELY A FORM OF STRESS-INDUCED MASS HYSTERIA. DANCERS CONTINUED FOR DAYS UNTIL EXHAUSTION OR COLLAPSE!

data-rot.name: DATA ROT
data-rot.desc: GRADUAL CORRUPTION OF STORED INFORMATION THROUGH ACCUMULATED SMALL FAILURES. ERRORS COMPOUND QUIETLY UNTIL RETRIEVAL TURNS TA GARBAGE!

dengue.name: DENGUE FEVER
dengue.desc: A MOSQUITO-BORNE FLAVIVIRUS INFECTION. SUDDEN FEVER ACCOMPANIES SEVERE JOINT AN' BONE PAIN, EARNIN' IT DA NICKNAME BREAKBONE FEVER!

depression.name: CLINICAL DEPRESSION
depression.desc: A MOOD DISORDER MARKED BY PERSISTENT LOW MOOD AN' LOSS OF INTEREST IN ONCE-ENJOYABLE ACTIVITIES. FATIGUE AN' DISRUPTED SLEEP COMPOUND DA WEIGHT OF IT!

diabetes-1.name: TYPE 1 DIABETES
diabetes-1.desc: AN AUTOIMMUNE DISEASE IN WHICH DA IMMUNE SYSTEM DESTROYS DA PANCREAS'S INSULIN-PRODUCIN' CELLS. BLOOD SUGAR RISES UNCHECKED WITHOUT EXTERNAL INSULIN!

diabetes-2.name: TYPE 2 DIABETES
diabetes-2.desc: INSULIN RESISTANCE COMBINED WIT RELATIVE INSULIN DEFICIENCY. PERSISTENT THIRST, FREQUENT URINATION AN' SLOW-HEALIN' WOUNDS DEVELOP AS BLOOD SUGAR STAYS ELEVATED!

diabetic-neuropathy.name: DIABETIC NEUROPATHY
diabetic-neuropathy.desc: NERVE DAMAGE FROM PROLONGED HIGH BLOOD SUGAR, MOST COMMON IN DA FEET AN' LEGS. NUMBNESS PROGRESSES UNTIL INJURIES AN' ULCERS GO UNNOTICED!

diphtheria.name: DIPHTHERIA
diphtheria.desc: A CORYNEBACTERIUM DIPHTHERIAE INFECTION OF DA THROAT. A THICK GRAY MEMBRANE FORMS ACROSS DA AIRWAY, CHOKIN' OFF BREATH AS DA ILLNESS PROGRESSES!

doppelganger-panic.name: DOPPELGANGER PANIC
doppelganger-panic.desc: A DELUSIONAL MISIDENTIFICATION DISORDER IN WHICH FAMILIAR PEOPLE IZ BELIEVED TA HAB BEEN REPLACED BY IDENTICAL IMPOSTORS. PARANOIA HARDENS AROUND EVERY FAMILIAR FACE!

dream-plague.name: DREAM PLAGUE
dream-plague.desc: A CONTAGIOUS AFFLICTION OF DA SLEEPIN' MIND, PASSIN' NIGHTMARE CONTENT BETWEEN SUFFERERS. WAKIN' EXHAUSTION ACCUMULATES DESPITE HOURS SPENT APPARENTLY ASLEEP!

ebola.name: EBOLA
ebola.desc: A VIRAL HEMORRHAGIC FEVER SPREAD THROUGH CONTACT WIT BODILY FLUIDS. FEVER AN' MUSCLE PAIN PROGRESS RAPIDLY TA BLEEDIN' AN' MULTI-ORGAN FAILURE!

echinococcosis.name: HYDATID DISEASE
echinococcosis.desc: INFECTION BY TAPEWORM LARVAE DAT FORM SLOW-GROWIN', FLUID-FILLED CYSTS IN DA LIVER OR LUNGS. SYMPTOMS APPEAR ONLY ONCE A CYST GROWS LARGE ENOUGH TA PRESS ON SURROUNDIN' TISSUE!

elephantiasis.name: LYMPHATIC FILARIASIS
elephantiasis.desc: LYMPHATIC FILARIASIS, CAUSED BY THREAD-LIKE PARASITIC WORMS LODGED IN DA LYMPH VESSELS. CHRONIC BLOCKAGE CAUSES GROSS SWELLIN' OF DA LIMBS, CALLED ELEPHANTIASIS!

encephalitis-lethargica.name: SLEEPIN' SICKNESS OF DA BRAIN
encephalitis-lethargica.desc: A RARE BRAIN INFLAMMATION OF UNCERTAIN VIRAL ORIGIN. TREMOR AN' DOUBLE VISION CAN PROGRESS TA A STATUE-LIKE, UNRESPONSIVE STILLNESS!

endocarditis.name: INFECTIVE ENDOCARDITIS
endocarditis.desc: A BACTERIAL INFECTION OF DA HEART'S INNER LININ', USUALLY SETTLIN' ON A VALVE. FEVER AN' A NEW HEART MURMUR CAN PRECEDE EMBOLIC COMPLICATIONS ELSEWHERE IN DA BODY!

epilepsy.name: EPILEPSY
epilepsy.desc: A TENDENCY TOWARD RECURRENT SEIZURES CAUSED BY BURSTS OF ABNORMAL ELECTRICAL ACTIVITY IN DA BRAIN. EPISODES RANGE FROM BRIEF LAPSES TA FULL CONVULSIONS!

fainting-sickness.name: FAINTIN' SICKNESS
fainting-sickness.desc: A FORM OF MASS PSYCHOGENIC ILLNESS IN WHICH FAINTIN' SPELLS SPREAD THROUGH A GROUP. NAUSEA AN' DIZZINESS PRECEDE EACH COLLAPSE, WIT NO INFECTION TA EXPLAIN IT!

familiar-fever.name: FAMILIAR FEVER
familiar-fever.desc: A FEBRILE BLEED-THROUGH FROM A BONDED FAMILIAR'S INSTINCTS INTO DA HANDLER'S OWN BODY. HUNGER AN' REFLEXES SHIFT TOWARD DA FAMILIAR'S NATURE AS DA FEVER PEAKS AT NIGHT!

fatal-insomnia.name: FATAL FAMILIAL INSOMNIA
fatal-insomnia.desc: A PRION DISEASE DAT DESTROYS DA THALAMUS, DA BRAIN'S SLEEP-REGULATIN' RELAY. SLEEP BECOMES IMPOSSIBLE AS DA DISEASE PROGRESSES, FOLLOWED BY AUTONOMIC COLLAPSE!

fifth-disease.name: SLAPPED CHEEK
fifth-disease.desc: A MILD PARVOVIRUS B19 INFECTION, MOST RECOGNIZABLE BY DA BRIGHT RED RASH IT LEAVES ON DA CHEEKS. JOINT ACHE CAN FOLLOW IN OLDER CHILDREN AN' ADULTS!

fleas.name: FLEA INFESTATION
fleas.desc: SMALL JUMPIN' INSECTS DAT LIVE ON DA BLOOD OF A HOST. REPEATED BITES RAISE ITCHY WELTS AN' LEAVE DA SKIN RESTLESS AN' IRRITATED!

gangrene.name: GANGRENE
gangrene.desc: TISSUE DEATH FROM INTERRUPTED BLOOD SUPPLY, OFTEN SECONDARY TA INFECTION. SKIN DARKENS AN' BREAKS DOWN AS DA AFFECTED AREA LOSES CIRCULATION!

genital-theft-panic.name: GENITAL-STEALIN' WITCH PANIC
genital-theft-panic.desc: A CULTURE-BOUND DELUSIONAL PANIC CENTERED ON DA BELIEF DAT DA GENITALS IZ SHRINKIN' OR RETRACTIN' INTO DA BODY, SPREADIN' THROUGH FEAR AN' RUMOR RATHER DEN ANY PHYSICAL CAUSE!

gerd.name: CHRONIC GERD
gerd.desc: CHRONIC BACKFLOW OF STOMACH ACID INTO DA ESOPHAGUS. PERSISTENT HEARTBURN AN' REGURGITATION CAN ERODE DA ESOPHAGEAL LININ' OVER TIME!

giardiasis.name: GIARDIASIS
giardiasis.desc: A PROTOZOAN PARASITE OF DA SMALL INTESTINE, SPREAD THROUGH CONTAMINATED WATER. BLOATIN' AN' GREASY DIARRHEA FOLLOW INGESTION OF ITS CYSTS!

glossolalia-wave.name: SPEAKIN' SICKNESS
glossolalia-wave.desc: FLUID, SPEECH-LIKE VOCALIZATION WITHOUT COMPREHENSIBLE MEANIN', OFTEN ARISIN' IN A TRANCE-LIKE RELIGIOUS STATE. IT CAN SPREAD CONTAGIOUSLY THROUGH A GATHERED CROWD!

goiter.name: IODINE-DEFICIENCY GOITER
goiter.desc: ENLARGEMENT OF DA THYROID GLAND, MOST OFTEN FROM INSUFFICIENT DIETARY IODINE. A VISIBLE SWELLIN' FORMS AT DA NECK AS DA GLAND STRUGGLES TA KEEP UP!

gonorrhea.name: GONORRHEA
gonorrhea.desc: A SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED NEISSERIA GONORRHOEAE INFECTION OF DA GENITAL TRACT. DISCHARGE AN' BURNIN' ON URINATION, THOUGH INFECTION MAY BE SILENT!

graves.name: GRAVES' DISEASE
graves.desc: AN AUTOIMMUNE DISEASE DAT OVERSTIMULATES DA THYROID GLAND. RACIN' HEARTBEAT AN' BULGIN' EYES ACCOMPANY DA RESULTIN' EXCESS OF THYROID HORMONE!

gray-static.name: GRAY STATIC
gray-static.desc: A NEUROLOGICAL CONDITION PRODUCIN' A CONSTANT FIELD OF FLICKERIN' STATIC ACROSS DA VISUAL FIELD. TINNITUS AN' LIGHT SENSITIVITY OFTEN RIDE ALONGSIDE IT!

grimoire-tinnitus.name: GRIMOIRE TINNITUS
grimoire-tinnitus.desc: PERSISTENT RINGIN' LEFT BEHIND BY PROLONGED EXPOSURE TA SPOKEN INCANTATION. FRAGMENTS OF RECITED TEXT INTRUDE ON THOUGHT AN' DISRUPT SLEEP LONG AFTER DA READIN' ENDS!

guinea-worm.name: GUINEA WORM
guinea-worm.desc: A PARASITE ACQUIRED BY DRINKIN' WATER CONTAININ' INFECTED COPEPODS. DA ADULT WORM MIGRATES BENEATH DA SKIN FOR A YEAR BEFORE EMERGIN' THROUGH A BURNIN' BLISTER!

hand-foot-mouth.name: HAND, FOOT AN' MOUTH DISEASE
hand-foot-mouth.desc: AN ENTEROVIRUS INFECTION COMMON IN YOUNG CHILDREN. FEVER PRECEDES PAINFUL MOUTH ULCERS AN' BLISTERS ON DA PALMS AN' SOLES!

hantavirus.name: HANTAVIRUS
hantavirus.desc: A RODENT-BORNE VIRUS INHALED FROM CONTAMINATED DUST OR DROPPINGS. FEVER PROGRESSES TA SEVERE RESPIRATORY OR RENAL DISTRESS DEPENDIN' ON DA STRAIN!

hashimoto.name: HASHIMOTO'S THYROIDITIS
hashimoto.desc: AN AUTOIMMUNE DISEASE DAT GRADUALLY DESTROYS DA THYROID GLAND. FATIGUE AN' WEIGHT GAIN CREEP IN AS THYROID HORMONE OUTPUT SLOWLY FAILS!

hepatitis-a.name: HEPATITIS A
hepatitis-a.desc: A LIVER INFECTION FROM DA HEPATITIS A VIRUS, SPREAD BY CONTAMINATED FOOD OR WATER. NAUSEA, FATIGUE AN' JAUNDICE APPEAR TWO TA SIX WEEKS AFTER EXPOSURE!

hepatitis-b.name: HEPATITIS B
hepatitis-b.desc: BLOODBORNE OR SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED LIVER INFECTION. MANY CARRY IT SILENTLY; OTHERS DEVELOP FATIGUE AN' JAUNDICE AS DA LIVER INFLAMES!

hepatitis-c.name: HEPATITIS C
hepatitis-c.desc: A BLOODBORNE LIVER INFECTION OFTEN ACQUIRED SILENTLY. CHRONIC CASES CAN PROGRESS OVER YEARS TA SCARRIN' AN' LIVER FAILURE IF UNTREATED!

herpes-simplex.name: HERPES SIMPLEX
herpes-simplex.desc: A LIFELONG VIRAL INFECTION OF SKIN AN' NERVE TISSUE. PAINFUL, FLUID-FILLED BLISTERS RECUR AT DA SITE OF LATENCY, TRIGGERED BY STRESS OR ILLNESS!

histoplasmosis.name: HISTOPLASMOSIS
histoplasmosis.desc: A FUNGAL LUNG INFECTION FROM INHALIN' SPORES IN SOIL CONTAMINATED WIT BIRD OR BAT DROPPINGS. COUGH AN' FATIGUE FOLLOW EXPOSURE, USUALLY RESOLVIN' WITHOUT TREATMENT!

hiv.name: HIV
hiv.desc: A RETROVIRUS DAT INFECTS AN' DEPLETES CD4 IMMUNE CELLS. LEFT UNTREATED, PROGRESSIVE IMMUNE COLLAPSE LEAVES DA BODY OPEN TA OPPORTUNISTIC INFECTION!

hollow-shell.name: DA HOLLOW SHELL
hollow-shell.desc: AN ADVANCED STAGE OF SEVERANCE FROM DA SELF, IN WHICH DA BODY PERSISTS WITHOUT ITS USUAL SIGNS OF PRESENCE. NO REFLECTION IZ CAST, NO SHADOW FALLS, AN' DA VOICE DAT SPEAKS IZ NOT RECOGNIZABLY ONE'S OWN!

hollowing.name: DA HOLLOWIN'
hollowing.desc: A SLOW SEVERANCE BETWEEN BODY AN' SELF, OF UNCERTAIN ORIGIN. SENSATION AN' MEMORY FADE TOGETHER AS DA CONNECTION THINS, LEAVIN' COLD, UNRESPONSIVE SKIN BEHIND!

hookworm.name: HOOKWORM
hookworm.desc: INTESTINAL WORMS DAT ENTER THROUGH BARE SKIN AN' MIGRATE TA DA GUT, WHERE DEY FEED ON BLOOD. CHRONIC INFECTION PRODUCES ANEMIA AN' FATIGUE!

hpv.name: HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS
hpv.desc: A COMMON SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED DNA VIRUS. MOST INFECTIONS CLEAR ON DEY OWN; PERSISTENT STRAINS CAN CAUSE WARTS OR PRECANCEROUS CHANGES!

hypertension.name: HYPERTENSION
hypertension.desc: PERSISTENTLY ELEVATED BLOOD PRESSURE IN DA ARTERIES. IT RARELY CAUSES SYMPTOMS DIRECTLY BUT QUIETLY STRAINS DA HEART, KIDNEYS AN' BLOOD VESSELS!

ibs.name: IRRITABLE BOWEL SYNDROME
ibs.desc: A FUNCTIONAL DISORDER OF DA GUT WIT NO VISIBLE STRUCTURAL CAUSE. CRAMPIN' ABDOMINAL PAIN AN' IRREGULAR BOWEL HABITS RECUR OVER MONTHS OR YEARS!

influenza.name: INFLUENZA
influenza.desc: AN RNA VIRUS INFECTIN' DA RESPIRATORY TRACT. ONSET IZ ABRUPT: FEVER, MUSCLE ACHES, HEADACHE AN' A DRY COUGH DAT LINGERS AFTER DA FEVER BREAKS!

insomnia-chronic.name: CHRONIC INSOMNIA
insomnia-chronic.desc: PERSISTENT DIFFICULTY FALLIN' OR STAYIN' ASLEEP DESPITE DA OPPORTUNITY TA REST. DAYTIME FATIGUE AN' IRRITABILITY FOLLOW EACH POORLY SLEPT NIGHT!

iron-lung-curse.name: IRON LUNG CURSE
iron-lung-curse.desc: A CURSE DAT WEIGHS DOWN DA BREATH AS THOUGH DA LUNGS WAZ SLOWLY FILLIN' WIT METAL. A PERSISTENT METALLIC TASTE ACCOMPANIES EACH LABORED INHALE!

japanese-encephalitis.name: VIRAL ENCEPHALITIS
japanese-encephalitis.desc: A MOSQUITO-BORNE VIRUS DAT OCCASIONALLY CROSSES INTO DA BRAIN. MOST INFECTIONS PASS UNNOTICED, BUT DA MINORITY DAT INFLAME DA BRAIN BRING SEIZURES AN' PARALYSIS!

kuru.name: KURU
kuru.desc: A PRION DISEASE ONCE TRANSMITTED THROUGH RITUAL CONSUMPTION OF INFECTED BRAIN TISSUE. TREMORS AN' LOSS OF COORDINATION PROGRESS AS NEURONS DEGENERATE!

kwashiorkor.name: KWASHIORKOR
kwashiorkor.desc: SEVERE PROTEIN MALNUTRITION DESPITE ADEQUATE CALORIES. SWELLIN' FROM FLUID RETENTION AN' A DISTENDED, FATTY LIVER MARK ADVANCED CASES!

lassa.name: LASSA FEVER
lassa.desc: A RODENT-BORNE VIRAL HEMORRHAGIC FEVER ENDEMIC TA WEST AFRICA. MOST INFECTIONS IZ SILENT, BUT SEVERE CASES BRING FEVER, BLEEDIN' AN' PERMANENT HEARIN' LOSS!

laughing-pox.name: LAUGHIN' POX
laughing-pox.desc: A NEUROLOGICAL DISORDER PRODUCIN' SUDDEN, UNCONTROLLABLE LAUGHIN' OR CRYIN' UNRELATED TA ACTUAL MOOD. PUSTULES MARK DA SKIN WHERE DA FEVER HAB PASSED THROUGH!

laughter-epidemic.name: LAUGHTER EPIDEMIC
laughter-epidemic.desc: A DOCUMENTED OUTBREAK OF MASS HYSTERIA MARKED BY EPISODES OF UNCONTROLLABLE LAUGHTER SPREADIN' THROUGH A COMMUNITY, WITHOUT ANY INFECTIOUS AGENT INVOLVED!

leeches.name: LEECH INFESTATION
leeches.desc: BLOOD-FEEDIN' ANNELID WORMS DAT ATTACH WIT A SUCKER AN' RELEASE AN ANTICOAGULANT AS DEY FEED. BITES BLEED LONGER DEN EXPECTED AN' CAN ITCH FOR DAYS AFTER DA WORM DETACHES!

legionnaires.name: LEGIONNAIRES' DISEASE
legionnaires.desc: A FORM OF PNEUMONIA CAUSED BY LEGIONELLA BACTERIA, OFTEN FROM CONTAMINATED WATER SYSTEMS. FEVER AN' CONFUSION ACCOMPANY DA LUNG INFECTION!

leishmaniasis.name: LEISHMANIASIS
leishmaniasis.desc: A SANDFLY-BORNE PROTOZOAN INFECTION. DEPENDIN' ON DA SPECIES INVOLVED IT PRODUCES SKIN ULCERS, OR SPREADS INTERNALLY WIT FEVER AN' ORGAN SWELLIN'!

leprosy.name: LEPROSY
leprosy.desc: A SLOW MYCOBACTERIUM LEPRAE INFECTION OF SKIN AN' PERIPHERAL NERVES. NUMB PATCHES AN' LESIONS DEVELOP AS NERVE DAMAGE ACCUMULATES OVER YEARS!

ley-necrosis.name: LEY NECROSIS
ley-necrosis.desc: COLLAPSE OF A PERSONAL MANA CHANNEL UNDER CATASTROPHIC OVERDRAW, LEAVIN' DA SURROUNDIN' TISSUE WITHOUT CIRCULATION. NUMB SIGILS AN' COLD BLOOD MARK DA DEAD CHANNEL'S SPREAD!

ley-rot.name: LEY ROT
ley-rot.desc: CHRONIC OVERDRAW ON A PERSONAL MANA CHANNEL, WHICH BEGINS TA NECROTIZE UNDER SUSTAINED LOAD. BLEEDIN' MANA AN' NUMBNESS SPREAD FROM DA CHANNEL OUTWARD AS IT FAILS!

lice.name: HEAD LICE
lice.desc: INFESTATION OF DA SCALP BY DA HEAD LOUSE, SPREAD THROUGH DIRECT HAIR CONTACT. ITCHIN' FROM BITES MAY TAKE WEEKS TA DEVELOP ON A FIRST EXPOSURE!

listeriosis.name: LISTERIOSIS
listeriosis.desc: A FOODBORNE BACTERIAL INFECTION, DANGEROUS CHIEFLY TA DA IMMUNOCOMPROMISED, NEWBORNS AN' DA ELDERLY. FEVER AN' STIFF NECK CAN SIGNAL SPREAD TA DA NERVOUS SYSTEM!

liver-abscess.name: AMOEBIC LIVER ABSCESS
liver-abscess.desc: A PUS-FILLED CAVITY IN DA LIVER CAUSED BY AMOEBIC INFECTION. RIGHT-SIDED PAIN AN' FEVER DEVELOP AS DA PARASITE DESTROYS LIVER TISSUE FROM WITHIN!

liver-fluke.name: LIVER FLUKE
liver-fluke.desc: A FLATWORM PARASITE ACQUIRED FROM CONTAMINATED WATER PLANTS, WHICH MIGRATES TA DA LIVER'S BILE DUCTS. RIGHT-SIDED PAIN AN' JAUNDICE FOLLOW AS DA FLUKE SETTLES IN!

loop-amnesia.name: LOOP AMNESIA
loop-amnesia.desc: ANTEROGRADE AMNESIA: AN INABILITY TA FORM NEW MEMORIES AFTER DA TRIGGERIN' EVENT. LONG-PAST MEMORIES STAY INTACT EVEN AS DA PRESENT SLIPS AWAY UNRECORDED!

lupus.name: LUPUS
lupus.desc: AN AUTOIMMUNE DISEASE IN WHICH DA IMMUNE SYSTEM ATTACKS DA BODY'S OWN TISSUE. JOINT PAIN, FATIGUE AN' A CHARACTERISTIC FACIAL RASH FLARE AN' REMIT UNPREDICTABLY!

lycanthropy.name: LYCANTHROPY
lycanthropy.desc: A RARE DELUSIONAL SYNDROME IN WHICH DA SUFFERER IZ CONVINCED DEY CAN, OR HAB, TRANSFORMED INTO AN ANIMAL. DA CONVICTION PERSISTS DESPITE NO PHYSICAL CHANGE HAVIN' OCCURRED!

lyme.name: LYME DISEASE
lyme.desc: A TICK-BORNE BORRELIA INFECTION. A SPREADIN' BULLSEYE RASH IZ OFTEN DA FIRST SIGN, FOLLOWED BY JOINT PAIN AN' FATIGUE IF UNTREATED!

mad-cow.name: BOVINE SPONGIFORM ENCEPHALOPATHY
mad-cow.desc: A PRION DISEASE OF CATTLE DAT CAN CROSS TA HUMANS THROUGH CONTAMINATED TISSUE. ABNORMAL BEHAVIOR AN' LOSS OF COORDINATION PROGRESS AS BRAIN TISSUE TURNS SPONGY!

malaria.name: MALARIA
malaria.desc: A PLASMODIUM PARASITE CARRIED BY ANOPHELES MOSQUITOES, CYCLIN' THROUGH RED BLOOD CELLS. FEVER SPIKES AN' CHILLS RECUR ON A REGULAR SCHEDULE AS PARASITES BURST FREE!

mana-plague.name: MANA PLAGUE
mana-plague.desc: A TRANSMISSIBLE CORRUPTION OF DA BODY'S ARCANE CHANNEL, PROVOKIN' UNCONTROLLED DISCHARGE. FEVER AN' INVOLUNTARY SPELL MISFIRE FOLLOW AS DA CHANNEL LOSES CONTAINMENT!

mange.name: SARCOPTIC MANGE
mange.desc: A SKIN INFESTATION BY BURROWIN' MITES, MORE FAMILIAR IN ANIMALS BUT TRANSMISSIBLE TA PEOPLE. CRUSTED SKIN, HAIR LOSS AN' RELENTLESS ITCHIN' FOLLOW DA MITES' TUNNELIN'!

marburg.name: MARBURG FEVER
marburg.desc: A VIRAL HEMORRHAGIC FEVER CLOSELY RELATED TA EBOLA, CARRIED BY FRUIT BATS. SUDDEN FEVER AN' COLLAPSE PROGRESS TA UNCONTROLLED BLEEDIN'!

measles.name: MEASLES
measles.desc: A HIGHLY CONTAGIOUS PARAMYXOVIRUS SPREAD BY AIRBORNE DROPLETS. FEVER AN' CONJUNCTIVITIS PRECEDE A SPREADIN' RASH ROUGHLY TWO WEEKS AFTER EXPOSURE!

melioidosis.name: MELIOIDOSIS
melioidosis.desc: A SOIL-AN'-WATER-BORNE BACTERIAL INFECTION COMMON IN TROPICAL REGIONS. MOST EXPOSURES PASS UNNOTICED, BUT SYMPTOMATIC CASES RANGE FROM SKIN ABSCESS TA FEVER AN' PNEUMONIA!

meningitis.name: BACTERIAL MENINGITIS
meningitis.desc: BACTERIAL INFLAMMATION OF DA MEMBRANES AROUND DA BRAIN AN' SPINAL CORD. HIGH FEVER, STIFF NECK AN' SEVERE HEADACHE DEMAND URGENT TREATMENT!

migraine.name: CHRONIC MIGRAINE
migraine.desc: A NEUROLOGICAL DISORDER CAUSIN' RECURRIN', OFTEN ONE-SIDED HEADACHES. NAUSEA AN' SENSITIVITY TA LIGHT AN' SOUND ACCOMPANY DA WORST EPISODES!

miliary-tuberculosis.name: MILIARY TUBERCULOSIS
miliary-tuberculosis.desc: A WIDELY DISSEMINATED FORM OF TUBERCULOSIS DAT SPREADS TINY LESIONS THROUGH DA BLOODSTREAM TA MULTIPLE ORGANS. WASTIN' AN' FEVER ACCOMPANY DA FAILURE OF WHICHEVER ORGANS IZ SEEDED!

mirror-sickness.name: MIRROR SICKNESS
mirror-sickness.desc: A DISSOCIATIVE AFFLICTION IN WHICH ONE'S REFLECTION APPEARS TA LAG BEHIND ACTUAL MOVEMENT. SUFFERERS REPORT A GROWIN' DETACHMENT FROM DEY OWN ACTIONS AS DA DELAY WIDENS!

monkeypox.name: MONKEYPOX
monkeypox.desc: A VIRAL DISEASE RELATED TA SMALLPOX, SPREAD THROUGH CLOSE CONTACT. A BLISTERIN', CRUSTIN' RASH ACCOMPANIES FEVER AN' SWOLLEN LYMPH NODES, USUALLY RESOLVIN' WITHIN WEEKS!

mononucleosis.name: MONONUCLEOSIS
mononucleosis.desc: EPSTEIN-BARR VIRUS INFECTION, SPREAD THROUGH SALIVA. FEVER, SORE THROAT AN' SWOLLEN LYMPH NODES IZ ACCOMPANIED BY FATIGUE DAT CAN PERSIST FOR WEEKS!

mrsa.name: MRSA
mrsa.desc: A STAPHYLOCOCCAL STRAIN RESISTANT TA STANDARD BETA-LACTAM ANTIBIOTICS. SKIN ABSCESSES AN' INFECTIONS DAT RESIST FIRST-LINE TREATMENT!

ms.name: MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS
ms.desc: AN AUTOIMMUNE DISEASE IN WHICH DA IMMUNE SYSTEM STRIPS DA INSULATIN' MYELIN FROM NERVE FIBERS. NUMBNESS, VISION LOSS AN' FATIGUE APPEAR AS DAMAGED NERVES MISFIRE!

mucormycosis.name: MUCORMYCOSIS
mucormycosis.desc: AN AGGRESSIVE FUNGAL INFECTION FAVORIN' DA IMMUNOCOMPROMISED. IT SPREADS RAPIDLY THROUGH SINUS AN' FACIAL TISSUE, LEAVIN' A BLACKENED ESCHAR IN ITS WAKE!

mumps.name: MUMPS
mumps.desc: VIRAL INFECTION OF DA SALIVARY GLANDS. FEVER AN' MALAISE GIVE WAY TA PAINFUL SWELLIN' OF DA PAROTID GLANDS AT DA JAWLINE!

myiasis.name: BOTFLY MYIASIS
myiasis.desc: INFESTATION OF LIVIN' TISSUE BY FLY LARVAE, WHICH BURROW IN AN' FEED AS DEY GROW. A MOVIN' LUMP UNDER DA SKIN OFTEN MARKS WHERE A LARVA HAB TAKEN HOLD!

name-theft-panic.name: NAME THEFT PANIC
name-theft-panic.desc: A MORAL PANIC IN WHICH FEAR OVER AN UNPROVEN THREAT SPREADS FASTER DEN ANY EVIDENCE FOR IT. SUSPICION OF STOLEN IDENTITY BREEDS MUTISM AN' DREAD!

narcolepsy.name: NARCOLEPSY
narcolepsy.desc: A DISORDER OF DA BRAIN'S SLEEP-WAKE REGULATION. SUDDEN DAYTIME SLEEP ATTACKS AN', IN SOME CASES, A COLLAPSE OF MUSCLE TONE STRIKE WITHOUT WARNIN'!

night-blindness.name: VITAMIN A DEFICIENCY
night-blindness.desc: VITAMIN A DEFICIENCY DAT IMPAIRS DA RETINA'S ABILITY TA ADAPT TA LOW LIGHT. DIFFICULTY SEEIN' AT DUSK IZ OFTEN DA FIRST SIGN, BEFORE DAYTIME VISION IZ AFFECTED!

nipah.name: NIPAH ENCEPHALITIS
nipah.desc: A BAT-BORNE VIRUS DAT CAN JUMP TA PIGS AN' HUMANS. FEVER AN' HEADACHE CAN PROGRESS TA FATAL BRAIN INFLAMMATION!

norovirus.name: NOROVIRUS
norovirus.desc: DA LEADIN' CAUSE OF ACUTE GASTROENTERITIS. SUDDEN VOMITIN' AN' WATERY, NON-BLOODY DIARRHEA SPREAD EASILY THROUGH CONTAMINATED HANDS AN' SURFACES!

null-syndrome.name: NULL SYNDROME
null-syndrome.desc: A DISSOCIATIVE DISORDER IN WHICH DA SELF FEELS DETACHED FROM ITS OWN BODY AN' THOUGHTS. DA WORLD TAKES ON AN UNREAL, MUFFLED DISTANCE!

numbers-compulsion.name: NUMBER STATION COMPULSION
numbers-compulsion.desc: A FIXATION ON SHORTWAVE NUMBERS STATIONS, DA CRYPTIC BROADCASTS ONCE USED TA RELAY CODED MESSAGES. COMPULSIVE TRANSCRIPTION AN' MONOTONE SPEECH FOLLOW PROLONGED LISTENIN'!

ocd.name: OCD
ocd.desc: A DISORDER OF INTRUSIVE, UNWANTED THOUGHTS RELIEVED ONLY BY REPEATED RITUAL BEHAVIOR. DA COMPULSION OFFERS BRIEF RELIEF BEFORE DA OBSESSION RETURNS!

packet-fever.name: PACKET FEVER
packet-fever.desc: AN OBSESSIVE FIXATION ON NETWORK CONGESTION AN' DROPPED CONNECTIONS. FRUSTRATION AN' RESTLESSNESS BUILD IN STEP WIT EVERY STALLED PACKET!

parkinsons.name: PARKINSON'S DISEASE
parkinsons.desc: A NEURODEGENERATIVE DISEASE DAT DEPLETES DOPAMINE-PRODUCIN' NEURONS. TREMOR, RIGIDITY AN' SLOWED MOVEMENT WORSEN GRADUALLY OVER YEARS!

pellagra.name: PELLAGRA
pellagra.desc: NIACIN DEFICIENCY CAUSIN' DAMAGE ACROSS SKIN, GUT AN' BRAIN. UNTREATED, IT PROGRESSES THROUGH DA CLASSIC TRIAD OF DERMATITIS, DIARRHEA AN' DEMENTIA!

pelvic-inflammatory.name: PELVIC INFLAMMATORY DISEASE
pelvic-inflammatory.desc: AN ASCENDIN' BACTERIAL INFECTION OF DA UPPER FEMALE REPRODUCTIVE TRACT, OFTEN SILENT AT FIRST. UNTREATED, IT CAN SCAR DA FALLOPIAN TUBES AN' CAUSE INFERTILITY!

petro-lung.name: PETRO LUNG
petro-lung.desc: PNEUMOCONIOSIS: INTERSTITIAL LUNG SCARRIN' FROM YEARS OF INHALED FINE PARTICULATE. BREATH GROWS SHORTER AN' SHALLOWER LONG AFTER DA EXPOSURE DAT CAUSED IT HAB ENDED!

phantom-gasser.name: PHANTOM GASSER PANIC
phantom-gasser.desc: A DOCUMENTED PANIC INVOLVIN' REPORTED GAS ATTACKS WIT NO CONFIRMED PHYSICAL AGENT. NUMB LEGS AN' TERROR SPREAD THROUGH A COMMUNITY CONVINCED OF AN UNSEEN ASSAILANT!

phantom-infestation.name: PHANTOM INFESTATION
phantom-infestation.desc: A DELUSIONAL DISORDER IN WHICH DA SUFFERER IZ CONVINCED DEY BODY IZ INFESTED BY PARASITES DAT IZ NOT ACTUALLY PRESENT. DA ITCH FEELS REAL EVEN WITHOUT A CAUSE!

pinworm.name: PINWORM
pinworm.desc: A SMALL INTESTINAL WORM WHOSE FEMALES MIGRATE TA LAY EGGS AROUND DA ANUS AT NIGHT. DA RESULTIN' ITCH DISRUPTS SLEEP AN' SPREADS EGGS TA BEDDIN' AN' HANDS!

plague.name: BUBONIC PLAGUE
plague.desc: YERSINIA PESTIS INFECTION FROM FLEA BITES. FEVER AN' HEADACHE PRECEDE SWOLLEN, AGONIZIN' LYMPH NODES, OR BUBOES, NEAR DA SITE OF INFECTION!

pneumonia.name: BACTERIAL PNEUMONIA
pneumonia.desc: BACTERIAL INFECTION OF DA ALVEOLI. FEVER, PRODUCTIVE COUGH AN' SHORTNESS OF BREATH AS DA LUNGS FILL WIT INFLAMMATORY FLUID!

polio.name: POLIOMYELITIS
polio.desc: POLIOVIRUS INFECTION OF DA GUT, MOSTLY ASYMPTOMATIC. IN A MINORITY OF CASES DA VIRUS REACHES DA SPINAL CORD AN' DESTROYS MOTOR NEURONS, CAUSIN' PARALYSIS!

possession.name: POSSESSION
possession.desc: AN ALTERED STATE IN WHICH CONTROL OF SPEECH AN' MOVEMENT SEEMS TA PASS TA ANOTHER PRESENCE ENTIRELY. DA BODY ACTS AN' SPEAKS IN WAYS DA SUFFERER DOES NOT RECOGNIZE AS DEY OWN!

post-viral-syndrome.name: POST-VIRAL SYNDROME
post-viral-syndrome.desc: A DISABLIN' FATIGUE DAT PERSISTS LONG AFTER DA TRIGGERIN' INFECTION HAB CLEARED. EXERTION, EVEN MILD, BRINGS A MARKED WORSENIN' DAT CAN LAST FOR DAYS!

psoriasis.name: PSORIASIS
psoriasis.desc: AN AUTOIMMUNE SKIN DISEASE DAT ACCELERATES SKIN CELL TURNOVER. THICK, ITCHY PLAQUES OF BUILT-UP SKIN FORM ON DA SCALP, ELBOWS AN' KNEES!

ptsd.name: PTSD
ptsd.desc: A TRAUMA-LINKED DISORDER IN WHICH DA NERVOUS SYSTEM STAYS LOCKED IN THREAT MODE. FLASHBACKS AN' HYPERVIGILANCE PERSIST LONG AFTER DA DANGER HAB PASSED!

q-fever.name: Q FEVER
q-fever.desc: A BACTERIAL INFECTION CONTRACTED BY INHALIN' SPORES SHED BY INFECTED LIVESTOCK. FEVER AN' HEADACHE CAN PROGRESS TA PNEUMONIA IN A MINORITY OF CASES!

rabies.name: RABIES
rabies.desc: A NEAR-UNIVERSALLY FATAL VIRAL ENCEPHALITIS TRANSMITTED THROUGH DA BITE OF AN INFECTED ANIMAL. AGITATION, MUSCLE SPASMS AN' HYDROPHOBIA MARK DA TERMINAL STAGE!

recursion-sickness.name: RECURSION SICKNESS
recursion-sickness.desc: A COGNITIVE STRAIN FROM FOLLOWIN' A PROCESS DAT CALLS BACK INTO ITSELF WITHOUT A CLEAN END. THOUGHT LOOPS ON DA SAME UNRESOLVED STEP UNTIL IT COLLAPSES UNDER ITS OWN WEIGHT!

rheumatic-fever.name: RHEUMATIC FEVER
rheumatic-fever.desc: AN INFLAMMATORY DISEASE TRIGGERED BY AN UNTREATED STREP THROAT INFECTION. IT CAN INFLAME DA HEART, JOINTS, SKIN AN' BRAIN WEEKS AFTER DA ORIGINAL INFECTION CLEARS!

rheumatoid.name: RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS
rheumatoid.desc: AN AUTOIMMUNE DISEASE TARGETIN' DA JOINT LININ'. SYMMETRIC SWELLIN' AN' STIFFNESS, WORST AFTER REST, GRADUALLY ERODE JOINT FUNCTION!

rickets.name: RICKETS
rickets.desc: VITAMIN D DEFICIENCY IN GROWIN' BONE, LEAVIN' IT SOFT AN' PRONE TA BENDIN'. BONE PAIN AN' VISIBLE DEFORMITY DEVELOP AS DA SKELETON FAILS TA MINERALIZE!

ringworm.name: RINGWORM
ringworm.desc: A DERMATOPHYTE FUNGAL INFECTION OF DA SKIN, DESPITE DA NAME UNRELATED TA WORMS. A RED, SCALY, RING-SHAPED RASH SPREADS OUTWARD FROM DA POINT OF CONTACT!

river-blindness.name: RIVER BLINDNESS
river-blindness.desc: ONCHOCERCA WORMS, TRANSMITTED BY BLACKFLY BITES, RELEASE LARVAE DAT MIGRATE THROUGH DA SKIN AN' EYES. SEVERE ITCHIN' PRECEDES PROGRESSIVE VISION LOSS!

rotavirus.name: ROTAVIRUS
rotavirus.desc: A HIGHLY CONTAGIOUS GUT VIRUS COMMON IN YOUNG CHILDREN. PROFUSE WATERY DIARRHEA AN' VOMITIN' CAN CAUSE DANGEROUS DEHYDRATION WITHIN DAYS!

rubella.name: RUBELLA
rubella.desc: A GENERALLY MILD TOGAVIRUS INFECTION. HALF OF CASES PASS UNNOTICED; WHEN PRESENT, A FINE RASH AN' SWOLLEN LYMPH NODES APPEAR ABOUT TWO WEEKS AFTER EXPOSURE!

saints-fire.name: SAINT'S FIRE
saints-fire.desc: ERGOT ALKALOID POISONIN' FROM TAINTED GRAIN. BURNIN' LIMB PAIN AN' VIVID HALLUCINATION PRECEDE GANGRENE AS BLOOD VESSELS CONSTRICT!

salmonellosis.name: SALMONELLOSIS
salmonellosis.desc: A COMMON FOODBORNE BACTERIAL INFECTION. CRAMPIN', DIARRHEA AN' FEVER FOLLOW INGESTION OF CONTAMINATED FOOD, USUALLY RESOLVIN' WITHIN A WEEK!

sars.name: ATYPICAL PNEUMONIA
sars.desc: A CORONAVIRUS RESPIRATORY DISEASE FIRST IDENTIFIED IN 2002. DRY COUGH AN' FEVER PROGRESS TA DANGEROUSLY LOW BLOOD OXYGEN IN SEVERE CASES!

satanic-panic.name: SATANIC PANIC
satanic-panic.desc: A MORAL PANIC BUILT ON UNSUBSTANTIATED ACCUSATIONS, SPREADIN' THROUGH RUMOR AN' RECOVERED-MEMORY SUGGESTION RATHER DEN EVIDENCE. PARANOIA AN' INSOMNIA FOLLOW DA ACCUSATIONS!

scabies.name: SCABIES
scabies.desc: SKIN INFESTATION BY DA MICROSCOPIC MITE SARCOPTES SCABIEI, WHICH BURROWS INTO DA OUTER LAYER OF SKIN. INTENSE ITCHIN', WORSE AT NIGHT, FOLLOWS VISIBLE BURROW TRACKS!

scarlet-fever.name: SCARLET FEVER
scarlet-fever.desc: A STREPTOCOCCUS PYOGENES INFECTION PRODUCIN' AN ERYTHROGENIC TOXIN. SORE THROAT AN' FEVER ACCOMPANY A FINE, SANDPAPER-TEXTURED RASH!

schistosomiasis.name: SCHISTOSOMIASIS
schistosomiasis.desc: INFECTION BY PARASITIC FLATWORMS PICKED UP FROM FRESHWATER CONTAMINATED WIT SNAIL-BORNE LARVAE. EGGS LODGED IN TISSUE CAUSE CHRONIC INFLAMMATION AN' BLOOD IN DA URINE!

schizophrenia.name: SCHIZOPHRENIA
schizophrenia.desc: A DISORDER OF DISORGANIZED THOUGHT AN' PERCEPTION. HALLUCINATIONS AN' DELUSIONS DEVELOP GRADUALLY, TYPICALLY EMERGIN' IN YOUNG ADULTHOOD!

scrapie.name: SCRAPIE CONTACT
scrapie.desc: A PRION DISEASE OF SHEEP AN' GOATS, NOT KNOWN TA TRANSMIT TA HUMANS. RELENTLESS ITCHIN' AN' STUMBLIN' GAIT MARK ITS PROGRESSION IN DA ANIMALS IT AFFECTS!

scurvy.name: SCURVY
scurvy.desc: VITAMIN C DEFICIENCY DAT IMPAIRS COLLAGEN PRODUCTION THROUGHOUT DA BODY. BLEEDIN' GUMS, BRUISIN' AN' JOINT PAIN FOLLOW WEEKS WITHOUT FRESH PRODUCE!

sepsis.name: SEPSIS
sepsis.desc: A DYSREGULATED, BODY-WIDE RESPONSE TA INFECTION DAT DAMAGES DA BODY'S OWN TISSUES. FEVER, RAPID HEART RATE AN' CONFUSION SIGNAL ORGAN SYSTEMS FAILIN' IN CASCADE!

shigellosis.name: SHIGELLOSIS
shigellosis.desc: A BACTERIAL INTESTINAL INFECTION HISTORICALLY KNOWN AS DYSENTERY. BLOODY DIARRHEA AN' CRAMPIN' FOLLOW EXPOSURE TA REAL SMALL AMOUNTS OF DA BACTERIA!

shingles.name: SHINGLES
shingles.desc: REACTIVATION OF DORMANT VARICELLA-ZOSTER VIRUS IN NERVE TISSUE. A PAINFUL, BLISTERIN' RASH ERUPTS IN A BAND ON ONE SIDE OF DA BODY!

sigil-blight.name: SIGIL BLIGHT
sigil-blight.desc: DEGRADATION OF DA SKIN'S INSCRIBED WARDIN' SIGILS, CAUSIN' DEM TA SMEAR AN' MISFIRE. WARDS READ INCORRECTLY AN' ITCHIN' SPREADS ACROSS DA AFFECTED PALMS!

sleeping-sickness.name: AFRICAN SLEEPIN' SICKNESS
sleeping-sickness.desc: AFRICAN TRYPANOSOMIASIS, SPREAD BY DA TSETSE FLY. DA PARASITE EVENTUALLY CROSSES INTO DA BRAIN, DISRUPTIN' DA SLEEP-WAKE CYCLE AN' CLOUDIN' THOUGHT!

sleepwalk-pilgrimage.name: SLEEPWALKIN' PILGRIMAGE
sleepwalk-pilgrimage.desc: A PARASOMNIA IN WHICH WAKEFULNESS AN' DEEP SLEEP OCCUR IN DIFFERENT BRAIN REGIONS SIMULTANEOUSLY, DRIVIN' COMPLEX BEHAVIOR WITHOUT CONSCIOUS AWARENESS. GROUPS HAB BEEN KNOWN TA WALK IDENTICAL ROUTES TOGETHER!

smallpox.name: SMALLPOX
smallpox.desc: AN ERADICATED ORTHOPOXVIRUS DISEASE, HISTORICALLY DEVASTATIN'. FEVER PRECEDED A RASH OF FLUID-FILLED PUSTULES DAT SCARRED SURVIVORS FOR LIFE!

soul-sickness.name: SOUL SICKNESS
soul-sickness.desc: A WASTIN' OF DA SELF AT A LEVEL DEEPER DEN DA BODY, OF UNCERTAIN MECHANISM. GRIEF AN' ATTACHMENT FADE FIRST, FOLLOWED BY A THINNIN' OF ONE'S OWN SHADOW AN' NAME!

spanish-flu.name: GREAT INFLUENZA
spanish-flu.desc: A SEVERE H1N1 INFLUENZA STRAIN RESPONSIBLE FOR A GLOBAL PANDEMIC. RAPID ONSET OF HIGH FEVER AN' PULMONARY EDEMA TURNED LIPS AN' SKIN CYANOTIC!

sporotrichosis.name: SPOROTRICHOSIS
sporotrichosis.desc: A FUNGAL INFECTION INTRODUCED THROUGH A SKIN PUNCTURE, OFTEN FROM HANDLIN' PLANTS OR SOIL. FIRM NODULES FORM ALONG DA LYMPH VESSELS AN' LATER ULCERATE!

star-madness.name: STAR MADNESS
star-madness.desc: PROLONGED EXPOSURE TA NON-EUCLIDEAN COSMIC GEOMETRY OVERWHELMS DA MIND'S SPATIAL REASONIN'. PERSISTENT VISIONS AN' DREAD FOLLOW, OFTEN OUTLASTIN' DA EXPOSURE ITSELF!

static-communion.name: STATIC COMMUNION
static-communion.desc: A FIXATION ON ELECTRONIC VOICE PHENOMENA, DA FAINT PATTERNS SOME HEAR AS VOICES WITHIN RECORDED STATIC. LONG SESSIONS OF LISTENIN' LEAVE A CARRIER HUM RINGIN' IN DA EARS!

stone-flesh.name: STONE FLESH
stone-flesh.desc: A CURSE DAT GRADUALLY MINERALIZES SOFT TISSUE, BEGINNIN' AT DA EXTREMITIES. SKIN GREYS AN' STIFFENS AS FLEXIBILITY IZ TRADED FOR A SLOW, CREEPIN' RIGIDITY!

strep-throat.name: STREP THROAT
strep-throat.desc: BACTERIAL PHARYNGITIS FROM STREPTOCOCCUS PYOGENES. SUDDEN SORE THROAT, FEVER AN' INFLAMED TONSILS, WITHOUT DA COUGH TYPICAL OF VIRAL INFECTION!

syphilis.name: SYPHILIS
syphilis.desc: A STAGED TREPONEMA PALLIDUM INFECTION. A PAINLESS CHANCRE MARKS DA PRIMARY STAGE, FOLLOWED BY RASH AN', UNTREATED, DAMAGE TA DA NERVOUS SYSTEM!

tapeworm.name: TAPEWORM
tapeworm.desc: A RIBBON-LIKE INTESTINAL FLATWORM ACQUIRED FROM UNDERCOOKED MEAT. IT ABSORBS NUTRIENTS DIRECTLY THROUGH ITS BODY WALL, LEAVIN' DA HOST HUNGRY DESPITE EATIN'!

tarantism.name: TARANTISM
tarantism.desc: A HISTORICAL FORM OF MASS HYSTERIA ONCE BLAMED ON SPIDER BITE, MARKED BY FRENZIED DANCIN' SAID TA SWEAT DA VENOM OUT. SWEATIN' AN' MELANCHOLY ALTERNATE WIT DA FITS!

tertiary-syphilis.name: TERTIARY SYPHILIS
tertiary-syphilis.desc: DA LATE, UNTREATED STAGE OF SYPHILIS, YEARS AFTER DA ORIGINAL INFECTION. GUMMAS, DEMENTIA AN' DAMAGE TA DA HEART AN' SPINAL CORD MARK SYSTEMIC ORGAN INVOLVEMENT!

tetanus.name: TETANUS
tetanus.desc: TOXIN FROM CLOSTRIDIUM TETANI, ENTERIN' THROUGH A WOUND, CAUSES PROGRESSIVE MUSCLE RIGIDITY BEGINNIN' AT DA JAW AN' SPREADIN' THROUGH DA BODY!

the-quiet.name: DA QUIET
the-quiet.desc: A RARE COSMIC AFFLICTION DAT ERODES DA SUFFERER'S GRASP OF LANGUAGE AN' MEANIN'. WORDS LOSE DEY REFERENTS ONE BY ONE, LEAVIN' A FLAT AFFECT AN' AN EMPTY STARE!

ticks.name: TICK INFESTATION
ticks.desc: BLOOD-FEEDIN' ARACHNIDS DAT ATTACH FOR EXTENDED FEEDINGS, SWELLIN' AS DEY ENGORGE. LOCAL RASH AN' FATIGUE CAN FOLLOW, ALONG WIT ANY PATHOGEN DA TICK CARRIES!

tower-vertigo.name: TOWER VERTIGO
tower-vertigo.desc: A DISORDER OF BALANCE IN WHICH DA WORLD SEEMS TA SPIN OR TILT THOUGH NOTHIN' HAB MOVED. NAUSEA AN' UNSTEADY FOOTIN' FOLLOW ANY SUDDEN TURN OF DA HEAD!

toxoplasmosis.name: TOXOPLASMOSIS
toxoplasmosis.desc: INFECTION WIT DA TOXOPLASMA GONDII PARASITE, OFTEN FROM UNDERCOOKED MEAT OR CAT FECES. USUALLY MILD, BUT LINKED TA LASTIN' BEHAVIORAL CHANGE ONCE ESTABLISHED IN DA BRAIN!

trachoma.name: TRACHOMA
trachoma.desc: A CHLAMYDIAL EYE INFECTION AN' DA WORLD'S LEADIN' INFECTIOUS CAUSE OF BLINDNESS. REPEATED INFECTION SCARS DA EYELID, TURNIN' DA LASHES INWARD AGAINST DA CORNEA!

trichinosis.name: TRICHINOSIS
trichinosis.desc: A PARASITIC ROUNDWORM INFECTION FROM UNDERCOOKED MEAT. LARVAE MIGRATE INTO MUSCLE TISSUE, CAUSIN' SWELLIN', PAIN AN' FEVER AS DA BODY REACTS TA DEY PRESENCE!

tuberculosis.name: TUBERCULOSIS
tuberculosis.desc: A CHRONIC MYCOBACTERIUM TUBERCULOSIS INFECTION OF DA LUNGS. A PERSISTENT COUGH, WEIGHT LOSS AN' NIGHT SWEATS DEVELOP AS DA DISEASE BECOMES ACTIVE!

typhoid.name: TYPHOID FEVER
typhoid.desc: A SYSTEMIC SALMONELLA TYPHI INFECTION FROM CONTAMINATED FOOD OR WATER. FEVER CLIMBS IN STEPWISE FASHION OVER SEVERAL DAYS, WIT ABDOMINAL PAIN AN' RASH!

typhus.name: EPIDEMIC TYPHUS
typhus.desc: A LOUSE-BORNE RICKETTSIA INFECTION DAT SPREADS FASTEST THROUGH CROWDED, UNHYGIENIC CONDITIONS. HIGH FEVER AN' STUPOR FOLLOW DA ONSET OF A SPREADIN' RASH!

ulcer.name: PEPTIC ULCER
ulcer.desc: AN OPEN SORE IN DA STOMACH OR DUODENAL LININ', OFTEN LINKED TA BACTERIAL INFECTION OR LONG-TERM IRRITANT USE. BURNIN' PAIN TYPICALLY WORSENS OR EASES AROUND MEALS!

valley-fever.name: VALLEY FEVER
valley-fever.desc: COCCIDIOIDOMYCOSIS, A FUNGAL LUNG INFECTION FROM INHALED DESERT SOIL SPORES. FEVER, COUGH AN' RASH APPEAR IN DA MINORITY WHO DEVELOP SYMPTOMS!

void-touch.name: VOID TOUCH
void-touch.desc: SUSTAINED PROXIMITY TA A VOID-ADJACENT PHENOMENON LEAVES EXTREMITIES NUMB AN' HAIR FOLLICLES INERT. A PERVASIVE, OBJECTLESS DREAD ACCOMPANIES DA PHYSICAL SYMPTOMS!

wendigo-hunger.name: WENDIGO HUNGER
wendigo-hunger.desc: A CURSE DAT INVERTS DA BODY'S HUNGER SIGNAL PAST ANY SATIETY POINT. INSATIABLE CRAVIN', EXTREMITY FROSTBITE AN' MOUNTIN' PARANOIA PROGRESS TOGETHER AS DA AFFLICTION DEEPENS!

west-nile.name: WEST NILE VIRUS
west-nile.desc: A MOSQUITO-BORNE VIRUS. MOST INFECTIONS IZ SILENT; A MINORITY DEVELOP FEVER, HEADACHE AN', RARELY, NEUROINVASIVE DISEASE!

whipworm.name: WHIPWORM
whipworm.desc: A WHIP-SHAPED INTESTINAL PARASITE DAT EMBEDS ITS THIN END IN DA GUT LININ'. HEAVY INFECTIONS CAUSE BLOODY STOOL, CRAMPIN' AN' ANEMIA!

whisper-fever.name: WHISPER FEVER
whisper-fever.desc: A FEBRILE ILLNESS ACCOMPANIED BY AUDITORY HALLUCINATION, VOICES HEARD JUST BELOW DA THRESHOLD OF WORDS. FEVER RISES IN STEP WIT DA INTENSITY OF WHAT IZ HEARD!

whooping-cough.name: WHOOPIN' COUGH
whooping-cough.desc: A HIGHLY CONTAGIOUS BORDETELLA PERTUSSIS INFECTION. COLD-LIKE SYMPTOMS GIVE WAY TA WEEKS OF VIOLENT COUGHIN' FITS ENDIN' IN A CHARACTERISTIC WHOOP!

windscreen-pitting.name: WINDSCREEN PITTIN' DELUSION
windscreen-pitting.desc: A DOCUMENTED MASS PANIC IN WHICH PEOPLE BEGAN NOTICIN' ORDINARY WEAR ON GLASS AN' ATTRIBUTED IT TA A SHARED, INVISIBLE CAUSE. OBSESSIVE INSPECTION FOLLOWED DA RUMOR!

yellow-fever.name: YELLOW FEVER
yellow-fever.desc: A MOSQUITO-BORNE VIRAL HEMORRHAGIC FEVER. FEVER AN' MUSCLE ACHES CAN PROGRESS TA JAUNDICE, BLEEDIN' AN' LIVER FAILURE IN SEVERE CASES!

zika.name: ZIKA VIRUS
zika.desc: A MOSQUITO-BORNE FLAVIVIRUS, USUALLY MILD. LOW FEVER, JOINT PAIN AN' A FINE RASH RESOLVE WITHIN A WEEK, THOUGH INFECTION IN PREGNANCY CARRIES SEPARATE RISKS!

broken-arm.name: BROKEN ARM
broken-arm.desc: A FRACTURED BONE IN DA ARM, IMMOBILIZED IN A SPLINT OR CAST WHILE IT KNITS. STRENGTH ON DAT SIDE IZ HALVED UNTIL DA BONE HAB HEALED!

broken-leg.name: BROKEN LEG
broken-leg.desc: A FRACTURED LEG BONE, SET IN A CAST TA HOLD DA BREAK ALIGNED WHILE IT MENDS. EVERY STEP MUST BE TAKEN CAREFULLY TA AVOID DISTURBIN' DA HEALIN' BONE!

broken-rib.name: BROKEN RIB
broken-rib.desc: A CRACK IN ONE OR MORE RIBS, USUALLY FROM BLUNT TRAUMA. BREATHIN' DEEPLY, COUGHIN' OR TWISTIN' BRINGS A SHARP STAB OF PAIN UNTIL DA BONE KNITS!

concussion.name: CONCUSSION
concussion.desc: A MILD TRAUMATIC BRAIN INJURY FROM A BLOW TA DA HEAD. THINKIN' SLOWS AN' LIGHT OR NOISE BECOMES UNPLEASANT WHILE DA BRAIN RECOVERS!

sprained-ankle.name: SPRAINED ANKLE
sprained-ankle.desc: TORN OR OVERSTRETCHED LIGAMENTS AROUND DA ANKLE JOINT. SWELLIN' AN' INSTABILITY MAKE DA JOINT PROTEST UNDER WEIGHT UNTIL DA LIGAMENTS HEAL!

dislocated-shoulder.name: DISLOCATED SHOULDER
dislocated-shoulder.desc: DA UPPER ARM BONE FORCED OUT OF ITS SHOULDER SOCKET. DA JOINT IZ VISIBLY DEFORMED AN' USELESS UNTIL IT IZ REDUCED BACK INTO PLACE!

deep-laceration.name: DEEP LACERATION
deep-laceration.desc: A CUT THROUGH DA SKIN DEEP ENOUGH TA EXPOSE UNDERLYIN' TISSUE. IT REQUIRES CLOSURE AN' CAREFUL CLEANIN' TA PREVENT INFECTION WHILE IT HEALS!

severe-burns.name: SEVERE BURNS
severe-burns.desc: THERMAL INJURY DEEP ENOUGH TA DAMAGE MULTIPLE LAYERS OF SKIN. FLUID LOSS AN' INFECTION RISK RISE SHARPLY WIT DA SIZE AN' DEPTH OF DA BURN!

frostbite.name: FROSTBITE
frostbite.desc: TISSUE DAMAGE FROM PROLONGED EXPOSURE TA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURES. ICE CRYSTALS FORM WITHIN CELLS AS CIRCULATION TA DA EXTREMITY SHUTS DOWN TA PROTECT DA BODY'S CORE!

whiplash.name: WHIPLASH
whiplash.desc: A NECK INJURY FROM SUDDEN, FORCEFUL BACK-AN'-FORTH MOTION, STRAININ' MUSCLES AN' LIGAMENTS BEYOND DEY NORMAL RANGE. PAIN AN' STIFFNESS OFTEN WORSEN A DAY OR TWO AFTER DA INJURY!

spinal-injury.name: SPINAL INJURY
spinal-injury.desc: DAMAGE TA DA SPINAL CORD DAT DISRUPTS DA SIGNALS PASSIN' BETWEEN BRAIN AN' BODY. DA SEVERITY OF IMPAIRMENT DEPENDS ON WHERE ALONG DA CORD DA DAMAGE OCCURRED!

amputation.name: AMPUTATION
amputation.desc: SURGICAL OR TRAUMATIC LOSS OF A LIMB. DA BODY MUST RELEARN BALANCE AN' FUNCTION AROUND DA MISSIN' STRUCTURE!

cataract.name: CATARACT
cataract.desc: CLOUDIN' OF DA EYE'S NORMALLY CLEAR LENS, USUALLY DEVELOPIN' SLOWLY WIT AGE. VISION DIMS AN' BLURS AS DA LENS LOSES ITS TRANSPARENCY!

hearing-loss.name: HEARIN' LOSS
hearing-loss.desc: REDUCED ABILITY TA DETECT SOUND, FROM DAMAGE TA DA INNER EAR OR AUDITORY NERVE. IT CAN DEVELOP GRADUALLY FROM NOISE EXPOSURE OR AGE, OR ARRIVE SUDDENLY FROM INJURY!

chronic-back-pain.name: CHRONIC BACK PAIN
chronic-back-pain.desc: PERSISTENT PAIN ALONG DA SPINE, OFTEN FROM DEGENERATED DISCS OR STRAINED MUSCLE AN' LIGAMENT. IT FLARES WIT CERTAIN MOVEMENTS AN' RARELY RESOLVES COMPLETELY!

arthritis.name: OSTEOARTHRITIS
arthritis.desc: WEAR-RELATED BREAKDOWN OF JOINT CARTILAGE, MOST COMMON IN WEIGHT-BEARIN' JOINTS. PAIN AN' STIFFNESS WORSEN WIT USE AN' EASE WIT REST!

osteoporosis.name: OSTEOPOROSIS
osteoporosis.desc: PROGRESSIVE LOSS OF BONE DENSITY DAT LEAVES DA SKELETON POROUS AN' FRAGILE. FRACTURES CAN OCCUR FROM FALLS, OR STRAIN, DAT WOULD NOT BREAK HEALTHY BONE!

kidney-stones.name: KIDNEY STONES
kidney-stones.desc: HARD MINERAL DEPOSITS DAT FORM IN DA KIDNEY AN' CAN LODGE IN DA URINARY TRACT. PASSIN' ONE BRINGS WAVES OF SEVERE FLANK PAIN UNTIL IT CLEARS!

appendicitis.name: APPENDICITIS
appendicitis.desc: INFLAMMATION OF DA APPENDIX, USUALLY FROM A BLOCKAGE DAT TRAPS BACTERIA INSIDE. PAIN MIGRATES TA DA LOWER RIGHT ABDOMEN AN' WORSENS QUICKLY, REQUIRIN' PROMPT SURGERY!

hernia.name: HERNIA
hernia.desc: PROTRUSION OF INTERNAL TISSUE THROUGH A WEAK POINT IN DA SURROUNDIN' MUSCLE WALL. A VISIBLE BULGE APPEARS, OFTEN WIT A DRAGGIN' DISCOMFORT DAT WORSENS WIT STRAIN!

gout.name: GOUT
gout.desc: A FORM OF ARTHRITIS CAUSED BY URIC ACID CRYSTALS ACCUMULATIN' IN A JOINT. SUDDEN, INTENSE PAIN AN' SWELLIN' TYPICALLY STRIKE DA BIG TOE FIRST!

chronic-fatigue.name: CHRONIC FATIGUE SYNDROME
chronic-fatigue.desc: A DISABLIN' EXHAUSTION UNRELIEVED BY REST, OFTEN TRIGGERED BY ILLNESS OR PHYSICAL EXERTION. EVEN LIGHT ACTIVITY CAN BRING ON A CRASH DAT LASTS FOR DAYS!

phantom-limb.name: PHANTOM LIMB PAIN
phantom-limb.desc: PAIN FELT IN A LIMB DAT IZ NO LONGER DERE, AFTER AMPUTATION. DA BRAIN'S MAP OF DA BODY PERSISTS EVEN AFTER DA BODY ITSELF HAB CHANGED!

scar-tissue.name: OLD BATTLE SCARS
scar-tissue.desc: FIBROUS TISSUE LAID DOWN TA CLOSE A WOUND, REPLACIN' DA ORIGINAL SKIN'S STRUCTURE. IT IZ LESS FLEXIBLE AN' LESS SENSITIVE DEN DA TISSUE IT REPLACES!

cybernetic-rejection.name: CYBERNETIC REJECTION
cybernetic-rejection.desc: AN IMMUNE RESPONSE AGAINST IMPLANTED PROSTHETIC OR CYBERNETIC TISSUE. INFLAMMATION AN' PAIN BUILD AROUND DA INTERFACE AS DA BODY TREATS IT AS FOREIGN!

mana-burn-scars.name: MANA-BURN SCARS
mana-burn-scars.desc: PERMANENT TISSUE DAMAGE FROM AN ARCANE CHANNEL DAT OVERLOADED AN' DISCHARGED THROUGH DA BODY. DA SCARRIN' IZ INERT BUT MARKS WHERE DA BURN PASSED THROUGH!

cursed-brand.name: CURSED BRAND
cursed-brand.desc: A MARK BURNED INTO DA SKIN BY A CURSE, BINDIN' SOME LASTIN' EFFECT TA DA BEARER. IT DOES NOT FADE OR HEAL LIKE AN ORDINARY SCAR!

solomon-curse.name: SOLOMON'S CURSE
solomon-curse.desc: A BINDIN' AFFLICTION TIED TA AN ANCIENT SEAL, PASSED DOWN THROUGH CONTACT WIT WHAT IT WAZ MEANT TA CONTAIN. ITS EFFECTS TRACE DIRECTLY BACK TA DA TERMS OF DAT ORIGINAL BINDIN'!

ui.noRemedy: NOTHIN' IN DA WORLD TREATS DIS!
ui.incurableManaged: INCURABLE, CAN BE HELD IN CHECK
ui.undiagnosedDesc: SOMETHIN' IZ WRONG, AN' NOTHIN' YET SAYS WHAT!

toast.mildVomit: {actor} REACTS TA DA {source} AN' THROWS IT BACK UP!
